description: This file provides server entry point logic for a Remix-based application, handling server requests, differentiating between bot and browser clients, and managing server-side rendering streams using React and Node streams.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main request handler that sets response headers, identifies user-agent type, and delegates to bot or browser request handlers based on detection.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles requests from bots, renders React app to stream, and returns a server Response with the streamed HTML content.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles requests from browsers, renders React app to stream, and returns a server Response with the streamed HTML content.
